verdict: Source/ownership/eligibility invariants pass; unique-priority supervision is substantially underidentified. Preserve data; do not infer a capacity limit from this packet.
scope: ALL320 TRAIN rows only (160original+160purchasecontrasts), all20 situation grids/fourgenericvariants/twoquerysessions. No v4 reauditing, model predictions, future/private evaluation, GPU/browser/Git or data edits.
method: Read actual serialized backgrounds, histories, grade vectors and rationales. Independently classify every20-situation original/contrast pattern, then prove all80full-background grids and320rows map exhaustively to those patterns. No random sampling.
Call actual pure public checked_request and independently join every source event/targetvariant, budget and owned-positive check to frozen16-product catalog.
Compare exact model-visible checked contexts with opaque identifiers removed; also compare date-free versions for conflicting grade vectors.
Semantic classifications are auditor judgments about public support, not formal semanticvalidator scores or observed human preferences. No claim allunderidentified labels are false.
qualifications: No exact-input contradiction was found because all320model-visible inputs are distinct; this does not establish unique human preference for any ambiguous case.

All20situations allow reasonable recommendation inference;40rows have a distinct current problem/goal cue favoring the annotated leader,264single-maximum rows use more subjective complement ordering,16rows explicitly tie two maxima. These are qualitative categories, not benchmark results.

No explicit protected demographics/person names appear in request; fourgeneric home/routine suffixes vary with budgets/palette but functional grade vectors stay unchanged. The underidentified variable is relative need/priority, not demonstrated demographic-dependent target logic.
Grade0 means outside authored priorities, not universal irrelevance. Observed view/cart products sometimesreceive0whileotherproductsreceive1; no universal engagement-to-grade rule is established.
Activities already being performed do not prove missing equipment. Currentownershipabsenceforacomplementisnotproofthattheshopperlacksit.
Vaguely stated palette families support preference inference but not a uniquely explicit canonical shade; this audit verifies targetvariant factual existence, not exact preference correctness.
recommendations: Preserve frozen originals and failed model outcomes. Treat legacy as weak multi-item activity/complement supervision unless a separately versioned public request explicitly supplies a missing need and relative priority.
For source-supported dual needs without order, use set-valued indifference or relevance tiers with no invented unique target. Keep the16already-tiedcontrastmaxima set-valued.

Any future priority example should state current missing/fulfilled needs, public preferred order and replacement exception, and use genuine fixed-product view-to-purchase contrasts when measuring event-type sensitivity.

Before another capacity claim, test a predeclared objective/data plan that separates explicit-priority loss from uncertain complement preferences; do not retarget eval or optimize wording to observed misses.
